steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each test needs a result, each permit must be closed, and sign-off comes before service.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Permit not closed
findings.fix: Close the permit before the asset goes into service

findings.title: Sign-off missing before service
findings.fix: Get the sign-off before the asset is started

outcome.notChecked: Whether the asset performs to specification.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (2 high, 1 medium).
[high] test-pressure.md:12  Test with no result.
       Fix: Record the result before service.
[high] permit-confined.md:19  Permit not closed.
       Fix: Close the permit before the asset goes into service.
[medium] signoff-ops.md:26  Sign-off missing before service.
       Fix: Get the sign-off before the asset is started.
Not checked: Whether the asset performs to specification.
pros: Checks a test with no result, a permit not closed, and a sign-off missing before service.
cons: Not checked: Whether the asset performs to specification.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-commissioning-checklist skill on the records for this review.
